name: acp-harness
description: Vendor-agnostic ACP (Agent Client Protocol) harness: CLI/TUI, multi-provider plugin marketplace, bundled skills, and an MCP 2.0 server with ext-apps support.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/acp-client packages/marketplace packages/mock-agent packages/harness packages/mcp-server
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/acp-client packages/marketplace packages/mock-agent packages/harness packages/mcp-server && rimraf packages/*/dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --noEmit packages/acp-client packages/marketplace packages/mock-agent packages/harness packages/mcp-server
